Senses.Explanation: A fixed crash formula that dates the whole crossing on one sounding beat. Ruibai Mingxue tells the sick seat that one touch brings the crash and then they know their buddhahood is old, Tianyin Yuanxiu drills his hearers through walking, sitting, greeting, trading, eating, dressing, down to the privy, till with no more ground to probe the crash comes and they see the face they had before their parents, Poshan Haiming fixes the hour when the carried saying gives way and the tea-whisk staff and rush-leaf cushion turn new, Miyun Yuanwu writes the layman that whoever waits for the crash with his mind set on it will wait past the year of the donkey, and Baiyu Jingsi drops the great earth flat and splits the sky open first, then jeers that the turtle was never leaving the jar, crash or no crash. Fushi Tongxian opens the nine-week seclusion with the crash that opens the crown-eye and crosses from commoner to sage in a finger-snap, Yinyuan Longqi turns the newborn monk's borrowed phrase back on him and asks what the news of that crash is, Juelang Daosheng sets every brow and backbone of the retreat upright till the crash comes with open laughter and they may take their wooden bite from the staff-man, Baishan Dekai presses them to the hundred-foot pole where no going, no back, no staying helps, and the crash comes there with slow-opening eyes, still the old person with only the old walk changed, and Sanshan Denglai has the thing come by that very crash, treading through east and west, south and north.
